updateNote.en: The revised companion distinguishes solving the displayed examples, passing a hidden test and recovering the transformation on new inputs.
updateNote.zh: 本版分别说明通过题面样例、通过隐藏测试和在新输入上复现参考变换的含义。

en.title: When does an example force a second rule?
en.summary: Can a single string-replacement rule explain examples generated by two rules? Replacing one demonstration can rule out every legal one-rule solution. Across two models and the tested demonstration counts, this change lowers completion on the displayed tasks by 23.53–45.83 percentage points and raises success on a hidden distinguishing example by 8.40–13.45 points. Agreement on other strings remains much lower when both rules must act.

zh.title: 什么样的样例会迫使程序使用第二条规则？
zh.summary: 两条规则生成的字符串样例，是否非得用两条规则才能解释？替换一个展示样例，就能排除所有合法的单规则解。在两种模型和各个展示规模下，这一变化使完成题面的比例降低 23.53–45.83 个百分点，却使通过隐藏辨别样例的比例提高 8.40–13.45 个百分点。换到确实触发两条规则的其他字符串上，模型仍很少复现参考程序的输出。

description.en: Inspect the shortest legal solutions for a matched task pair or rebuild the outcome tables from 1,920 saved model runs on CPU.
description.zh: 查看一对匹配任务有哪些最短合法解，或在 CPU 上用 1,920 条已存模型轨迹重建结果表。

title.en: One changed demonstration rules out the shortcut
title.zh: 只换一个样例，单规则捷径便失效

en: A task shows six input–output pairs. Five stay fixed. In the control, the sixth maps iiiexa to iiiazy. Replacing exa with azy fits all six, but so does a longer program that first replaces ex with azw and then wa with y. The displayed outputs alone allow either explanation.

In the matched separation task the final pair becomes wbawex → wbayzw. The shortcut leaves wbawex unchanged. The two-step program produces wbawazw after its first rule and wbayzw after its second. All other demonstrations stay fixed. The figure traces both explanations on this archived task.
zh: 一道题给出六对输入输出，其中五对保持不变。对照题的第六对是 iiiexa → iiiazy。把 exa 换成 azy 就能解释全部六对。先把 ex 换成 azw、再把 wa 换成 y，也能解释它们。仅凭这组展示结果，两种解释都成立。
在配对的分离题中，把最后一组换成 wbawex → wbayzw。单规则捷径会原样保留输入；两步程序先得到 wbawazw，再得到 wbayzw。其余五组样例全部相同。下图给出了这对归档任务的完整构造。

alt.en: Worked example comparing the control and separation demonstrations and the one- and two-rule programs.
alt.zh: 图中比较对照与分离样例，以及单规则捷径和双规则参考程序。

caption.en: Figure 1. Read the last demonstration under each program. Both programs fit the control, but only the two-step reference produces wbayzw on the changed input. Enumeration checks every legal single rule.
caption.zh: 图 1。分别用两个程序处理最后一个展示样例。两者都符合对照题，换题后只有两步参考程序能在该输入上产生 wbayzw。穷举检查涵盖所有合法的单条规则。

title.en: Why the minimum is exactly two
title.zh: 怎样证明最短解恰好需要两条规则

en: Here a rule replaces every non-overlapping occurrence of a literal string. Rules run in sequence. The study fixes a finite alphabet, a left-hand side of one to three characters and a right-hand side of up to three. A changed output rules out the empty program. The verifier enumerates the legal one-rule explanations and executes a two-rule witness.

One legal single rule fits the control and none fits its partner. A changed output also excludes the empty program. Because the reference executes successfully in both tasks, these checks fix the minimum lengths at one and two. The verifier uses only the displayed pairs, before either model sees them. Its guarantee is relative to the specified replacement language and rule lengths.
zh: 每条规则替换字符串中所有互不重叠的字面匹配，多条规则按顺序执行。研究固定有限字母表，左侧长度为一至三个字符，右侧长度最多三个字符。一组发生变化的输出即可排除空程序。验证器随后枚举全部合法单规则解释，并实际执行一个双规则解。
对照题有一条合法单规则解。在与它配对的另一道题上，单规则解为零。至少有一个输出发生变化，也排除了空程序。两步参考程序在两道题上都能执行并通过，因此最短解分别为一条和两条规则。核验发生在模型看到题目之前，只用展示样例。这个保证限于预先规定的替换语言及规则长度。

title.en: Displayed completion falls as hidden-test success rises
title.zh: 题面完成率下降，隐藏样例通过率上升

en: Each of the 120 reference families supplies matched control and separation tasks with three to six shared examples, plus one arm-specific example. The panel contains 1,440 new trajectories and 480 previously saved base-five trajectories for Qwen3-8B and Olmo-3-7B-Think. The certified comparison uses 119 families at bases three and four and all 120 at bases five and six.

With five shared examples, Qwen satisfies all displayed pairs in 67 of 120 control tasks and 12 of their partners. Olmo’s counts are 52 and 15. Both models are more likely to pass a separate input–output pair omitted from both prompts. The table pairs tasks by reference family. Differences are in percentage points, with pointwise 95% intervals.
zh: 120 个参考程序家族在三至六个共享样例下各生成一对任务，并各加一个对照或分离样例。两种模型为 Qwen3-8B 和 Olmo-3-7B-Think，共有 1,440 条新轨迹和 480 条先前保存的五共享样例轨迹。三个、四个共享样例时各有 119 个家族通过配对认证，五个、六个时各有 120 个。
固定五个共享样例时，Qwen 在 120 道对照题中完成 67 道，在对应的双规则必需题中完成 12 道。Olmo 分别完成 52 道和 15 道。两种模型在另外一对从未展示的输入输出上，通过率反而提高。表中按参考程序家族配对，差值用百分点表示，并列出各项的 95% 区间。

caption.en: Five shared demonstrations and one changed demonstration, with 120 matched families per model. Δ is separation minus control. Across all eight settings, displayed completion falls by 23.53–45.83 points while hidden-test success rises by 8.40–13.45 points.
caption.zh: 每个模型均有 120 个配对家族。这一行设定为五个共享样例加一个改变的样例，Δ 是双规则必需题减对照题。在全部八个设置中，题面完成率下降 23.53–45.83 个百分点，隐藏样例通过率上升 8.40–13.45 个百分点。

title.en: How often do programs agree on new inputs?
title.zh: 换一批新输入，模型与参考程序的输出有多大比例一致？

en: The hidden pair was chosen to distinguish programs. A second evaluation draws 32 uniform strings and 32 strings that activate both reference rules for each family. Uniform-input agreement falls in every model and base-count setting. Of the 3,840 uniform inputs, 3,325 map to themselves under the reference.

On strings that activate both reference rules, programs returned for the separation task agree with the reference on only 1.93–5.78% of inputs across settings. With five shared examples, agreement is 2.76% for Qwen and 2.01% for Olmo. Passing one test chosen to expose a shortcut leaves substantial uncertainty about what the program does on other strings.
zh: 隐藏见证配对是为区分程序而选择的。第二组评估则为每个家族抽取 32 个均匀输入和 32 个能触发两条规则的输入。在全部模型和共享样例数设置下，均匀输入上的一致率都下降。3,840 个均匀输入中，有 3,325 个经过参考程序后保持原样。
在同时触发两条参考规则的字符串上，各设置中双规则必需题所得程序与参考程序的输出一致率只有 1.93%–5.78%。固定五个共享样例时，Qwen 为 2.76%，Olmo 为 2.01%。即使通过专门用来识别捷径的一道测试，仍很难据此推断程序在其他字符串上会做什么。

title.en: An unchanged string can still decide the minimum
title.zh: 输出原样返回，也可能决定最少需要几条规则

en: In another family, the reference replaces f with fdd and then db with c. The displayed string iyxbdc stays unchanged. The candidate rule b → dc would return iyxdcdc, so this apparently uneventful example excludes it. Removing the example at the smaller demonstration counts restores a one-rule solution. The family was selected from this change in its certificate before examining model outcomes.
zh: 另一组任务的参考程序先将 f 换成 fdd，再将 db 换成 c。输入 iyxbdc 时输出原样返回，但候选单规则 b → dc 会给出 iyxdcdc。因此，恰是这个“什么也没变”的样例排除了该候选。在较少展示样例的设置里，删掉它便重新出现单规则解。选取这个家族的依据是证书的变化，选例时尚未查看模型表现。

title.en: Run the certificate check and reconstruct the three tables
title.zh: 核验证书并重建三张结果表

en: Extract the release, enter its top-level folder and run the first two commands with Python 3.11 or later. The third uses NumPy and writes to a new directory. It verifies 960 certificates, 7,680 reference labels and the saved programs, then compares the three reconstructed tables with their archived counterparts.

The 120-family experiment can be replayed from the released task specifications and saved trajectories. The result map separately lists the earlier discovery and timed-search studies. For the retrospective list of 1,008 tasks, the historical sampling and filtering steps remain unresolved, which limits what that list can establish about task frequencies.
zh: 解压版本包并进入顶层目录。用 Python 3.11 或更新版本运行前两条命令即可核对文件和图 1 实例。第三条使用 NumPy，将结果写入新目录；它复核 960 份证书、7,680 个参考标签与保存的程序，并把三张重建结果表逐一对照归档。
120 个家族的配对实验可用已发布的任务说明和模型轨迹回放。早期发现性分析和限时搜索实验另列在结果索引中。对回顾性的 1,008 项任务，历史抽样和筛选过程尚未厘清，因此无法据此可靠估计各类任务的出现频率。
